content_blocks.heading_text: Project Management Careers at Fort Liberty and Beyond
content_blocks.text:
Fort Liberty stands as Fayetteville's largest employer and primary driver of project management demand across the region. The U.S. Army installation's ongoing facility modernization and infrastructure upgrades create sustained opportunities for certified project managers within military contracting and logistics support roles. Beyond the base, Cape Fear Valley Health System's expansion projects and the Fayetteville Outer Loop highway construction represent major undertakings where structured project oversight is critical. Healthcare systems, manufacturing operations like the Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company plant, and municipal agencies including the City of Fayetteville and Fayetteville Public Works Commission all actively seek professionals who can demonstrate competency in planning, execution, and risk management.

The PMP® and CAPM® credentials carry tangible weight in Fayetteville's job market. content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fayetteville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—typically a combination of formal education and documented hours leading projects or teams. Granite PM Academy staff can help you assess whether you meet the requirements.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. You'll earn the required contact hours through interactive sessions with experienced instructors. This formal education covers the PMBOK® Guide and prepares you for exam content while fitting Fayetteville's working schedules.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your training hours, submit your PMP application directly to PMI through their portal. Include your education, project experience, and proof of contact-hour completion from Granite PM Academy. Pay the associated exam fee to finalize your application and schedule your exam window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation support, including practice questions, study guides, and review sessions tailored to PMP content domains. Schedule your proctored exam when ready, then take it online or at an authorized test center. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP credential is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved learning activities, training, or volunteer work. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing courses and workshops to help you meet your PDU requirements and stay current in project-management practice.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
